MOKI 白板 for DSH。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# MOKI Canvas for DSH"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"简体中文 · Install with DSH · Import formats · Download · DSH plugin community"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**A local-first canvas for thinking, creating, and working with DeepSeek Harness.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"MOKI Canvas brings an editable infinite canvas into DSH's side workspace. Sketch an idea, grow it in"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"to a mind map, collect references, and keep notes, images, files, audio, and video together. Your selection becomes a text reference and "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"an image attachment in the current draft. You decide when to send it. A six-page, fully editable int"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"roduction board lets you explore the tools through a playful camping-film project."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## See it in action"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"These are real, dark-theme DSH interface captures from a separate demo profile containing only the b"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"undled introduction. The sidebar entry, conversation composer and side workspace stay visible, so yo"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"u can see how the plugin works inside DSH. No personal boards, accounts, chat history, or local path"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"s are included. The visible prompts are unsent demonstration drafts."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**1. Open a canvas beside your conversation.**"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**2. Select content on the right. A selection hint appears beside the DSH composer.**"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**3. Click Add to chat. The text reference and screenshot join your draft; your typed request is pre"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"k Add to chat. The text reference and screenshot join your draft; your typed request is preserved.**"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**4. Edit the canvas directly, or prepare a request for DSH. Here, a mind-map node is selected and i"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ts width is adjusted.**"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"More interactions inside DSH: drawing, materials, previews and page navigation"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## What you can do"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **Draw and arrange:** sticky notes, text, shapes, arrows, freehand strokes, Bézier paths, alignmen"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"t, grouping, zoom, and a minimap.
- **Build real mind maps:** edit node text and width, drag branche"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"s, collapse or expand them, and add nodes with Tab or Enter. DSH can add up to 200 nodes in one batc"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"h while preserving hierarchy.
- **Keep references nearby:** add images, files, links, audio, and vid"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"eo; search, locate, rename, and preview items from the page's materials list.
- **Organize a project"},{"id":"p15s6","text":":** multiple pages and page groups, editable boards, version history, `.moki` import/export, and ima"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"ge export.
- **Collaborate with DSH:** canvas tools register automatically. Ask the agent to inspect"},{"id":"p15s8","text":", create, update, arrange, or export content without setting up a separate MCP server.
- **Share a s"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"election deliberately:** a composer hint previews the active selection; clicking adds its text and s"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"creenshot to the draft, preserving what you have typed. It does not send a message automatically.
- "},{"id":"p15s11","text":"**Learn by editing:** the bundled introduction contains six pages, native mind-map nodes, an expanda"},{"id":"p15s12","text":"ble materials group, and small offline media examples."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Supported imports"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Drop files onto the canvas, paste images or URLs, or add materials from the toolbar. The following d"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"escribes importing and previewing in **DSH plugin v1.5.2**:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Type | Formats | Behavior in the canvas |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Images | PNG, JPG / JPEG, WebP, GIF, AVIF, BMP, SVG | Place, move, resize, and view images on the "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"canvas |
| Video | MP4, WebM, M4V, MOV, OGV, MKV, AVI | Recognized as video cards; playback depends "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"on DSH's embedded browser and the file's codecs |

| PDF | `.pdf` | Stored as "},{"id":"p19s5","text":"file cards, with paginated previews in the materials dialog |
